headline: St rong Q2; Textile to lead H2FY27

highlights: Q 2F Y2 7 performance : KPR reported 19% YoY growth in consolidated revenues to Rs.1939.7cr.
Textile business revenues grew by 16.6% YoY growth to Rs.1478.7cr and sugar business revenues grew by 27% YoY to Rs.436.1cr.
Consolidated gross margins improved by 490bps YoY to 44.4% while EBITDA margins improved by 640bps YoY to 25.7%.
Textile business EBIT margins improved by 606bps YoY to 24.9% while Sugar business margins improved to 16.8% witnessing ~3x expansion on YoY basis.
